description: Test suite for role management API endpoints in Mattermost, including role retrieval, patching, and validation of permissions and access control.

methods.name: TestGetAllRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all roles with different client permissions and admin levels.

methods.name: TestGetRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific role by ID, including error handling for invalid IDs.

methods.name: TestGetRoleByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a role by name, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: TestGetRolesByNames
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple roles by their names, including edge cases and validation.

methods.name: TestPatchRole
methods.description: Tests updating role permissions, access restrictions, and validation of permission changes.
